fusions.name: Heel Nip
fusions.desc: A bite at the target's heels that deals 4 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 35% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. For 2 seconds after, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Brought to Bay
fusions.desc: Runs down a target up to 7 tiles away and strikes for 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. It leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Leash
fusions.desc: Looses a hound that fights beside you for 12 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds. You move 25% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Quickening Chase
fusions.desc: Each kill builds a stack, up to 3. At 3, they are spent at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
